text:
marco_docs: heads-up: PR #4278 (SDK snippets + migration note for Dedicated) is ready for review. Vercel preview shows a 500 on /dedicated/config when visiting via the preview URL. Need at least one tech reviewer and a merge slot tomorrow morning. preview: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/deployments/preview-4278 :eyes:

vercel-bot: Build completed with warnings; route handler returned 500 for /dedicated/config. Logs: https://vercel-logs.example/4278

marco_docs: I ran mkdocs build locally and the page renders fine. suspect edge route handling or a missing _redirects rule. also updated the Rust SDK snippet to use the new client init example.

tia_ce: pinging alex_sre for routing help. alex, do we have previous patterns for Vercel previews that require an api/ route stub?

alex_sre: yes, sometimes our preview environment ignores rewritten paths if vercel.json lacks the proper rewrites. can you paste vercel.json and the index.md frontmatter?

marco_docs: vercel.json: `{ "rewrites": [{ "source": "/dedicated/config", "destination": "/dedicated/index.html" }] }` frontmatter: `title: Dedicated deployment networking layout` and a custom `permalink: /dedicated/config/` in the markdown.

alex_sre: ok. quick check: Vercel rewrites usually require a leading slash in destination. try `"destination": "/dedicated/index.html"` (you already have it) but also confirm the file exists under site/dedicated/index.html after mkdocs build. if mkdocs emitted `dedicated/config/index.html` instead, the rewrite won't match.

marco_docs: good point. locally mkdocs produced `site/dedicated/config/index.html`. I had assumed `index.html` at root of /dedicated. pushing a commit to change rewrite to `"destination": "/dedicated/config/index.html"` and update RFC note in the PR.

vercel-bot: Redeploy triggered for preview-4278.

deploy-bot: Reminder: merging docs PRs between 06:00-08:00 UTC is preferred to align with the staging deploy. If you need an out-of-window merge, request explicit approval here.

marco_docs: requesting merge slot at 06:30 UTC tomorrow. reviewers: @tia_ce and @alex_sre. I'm also adding a local repro snippet in the PR: `mkdocs build && python -m http.server --directory site 8001` and open `http://localhost:8001/dedicated/config/`.

vercel-bot: Preview succeeded and page served at https://preview-4278--redwood-docs.vercel.app/dedicated/config/ :white_check_mark:

tia_ce: reviewing now. small nit: the code block has mismatched backticks in the Rust snippet. not blocking.

alex_sre: routing looks good now. approved from infra side.

marco_docs: thanks! I'll hold for final signoff then queue merge for 06:30 UTC slot. leaving the PR open for any last PM review. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
